version.validation: Run pveversion on MS-01 and record the installed Proxmox VE version.

node.validation: Run hostname on the Proxmox node and match it to the cluster node name.

physical_cores.validation: Read physical core count from lscpu on MS-01.

physical_threads.validation: Read online CPU count from lscpu on MS-01.

usable_memory_mib.validation: Record Proxmox host usable memory in MiB after host reservation.

storage_pools.validation: Export pvesm status and record every pool used by platform guests with usable and free GiB.

existing_committed_vcpu.validation: Sum configured vCPUs for all existing Proxmox guests.

existing_committed_memory_mib.validation: Sum configured memory MiB for all existing Proxmox guests.

existing_committed_storage_gib.validation: Sum allocated disk GiB on the selected platform datastore for existing guests.

measurement_timestamp.validation: Record an RFC 3339 timestamp when all host capacity facts are measured.

bridge.validation: Confirm the Proxmox bridge attached to the LAN.

vlan.validation: Confirm the platform VLAN ID or explicitly verify that the LAN is untagged.

subnet.validation: Record the LAN subnet in CIDR form from Mikrotik.

gateway.validation: Record the LAN gateway IPv4 from Mikrotik.

dns_suffix.validation: Confirm the DNS suffix used for homelab application and service names.

dhcp_exclusion_static_range.validation: Reserve and collision-check a static IPv4 range outside dynamic DHCP leases.

npm_identity.validation: Record and resolve the stable LAN DNS name and IPv4 of Nginx Proxy Manager.
npm_identity.source: Mikrotik DNS and NPM host configuration

mode.validation: Operator must approve this CPU accounting mode before provisioning.

threshold.validation: Operator must approve a minimum of 20 percent physical threads left uncommitted.

accounting_basis.value: existing committed vCPU plus proposed vCPU compared with measured physical threads
accounting_basis.validation: Confirm all guests are included and measurements are current.

approval_status.validation: Operator records approval after reviewing measured capacity and workload contention risk.

rationale.value: Retain measurable CPU scheduling headroom on the single physical host.
rationale.validation: Operator confirms the reserve is appropriate for MS-01 workloads.

minimum_memory_headroom_percent.validation: Operator must approve at least 20 percent of usable RAM remaining unallocated.

minimum_storage_headroom_percent.validation: Operator must approve at least 20 percent of usable datastore capacity remaining unallocated.

disk_gib.validation: Approve against datastore capacity and backup retention.

ipv4.validation: Reserve and collision-check a stable IPv4 outside DHCP.

dns.validation: Assign a stable LAN name under the verified DNS suffix.

delay_seconds.validation: Tune after measuring native PostgreSQL readiness.

ipv4.validation: Reserve and collision-check a stable IPv4 outside DHCP.

dns.validation: Assign a stable LAN name under the verified DNS suffix.

delay_seconds.validation: Tune after measuring native Valkey readiness.

disk_gib.validation: Approve against datastore capacity and JetStream bounds.

ipv4.validation: Reserve and collision-check a stable IPv4 outside DHCP.

dns.validation: Assign a stable LAN name under the verified DNS suffix.

delay_seconds.validation: Tune after measuring NATS JetStream readiness.

ipv4.validation: Reserve and collision-check a stable IPv4 outside DHCP.

dns.validation: Assign a stable LAN name under the verified DNS suffix.

order.validation: Approve ordering after PostgreSQL and NATS.

ipv4.validation: Reserve and collision-check a stable IPv4 outside DHCP.

dns.validation: Assign a stable LAN name under the verified DNS suffix.

guests.lifecycle_constraint: observe-only; this inventory does not authorize resizing or reprovisioning

observed_guest_id.validation: Read the existing Zitadel LXC guest ID from Proxmox without changing it.

vcpu.validation: Observe current configured vCPU; do not resize.

memory_mib.validation: Observe current configured memory; do not resize.

disk_gib.validation: Observe current configured disk; do not resize.

ipv4.validation: Observe and verify the existing stable Zitadel IPv4.

dns.validation: Observe and resolve the existing Zitadel LAN DNS name.

order.validation: Observe current Proxmox startup order; do not change it in this phase.

delay_seconds.validation: Observe current startup delay; do not change it in this phase.

measurement_source.validation: Record the non-secret Proxmox command or UI view used for all observations.

responsibilities.boundary: Proxmox guests and explicitly declared external infrastructure; never Kubernetes resources
Software and operating-system configuration inside provisioned native-service LXCs and VM
Desired state inside k3s only; never guests, routers, DNS providers, or proxy lifecycle
Existing Zitadel and other retained systems unless a later approved contract changes ownership

credentials.minimum_scope: Dedicated role limited to required VM/LXC and storage lifecycle on the target node
credentials.storage_location: operator-managed secret store; injected at execution time
credentials.rotation_revocation: Rotate in Proxmox and update the execution secret store; revoke the old identity after a successful read-only plan.
credentials.acquisition_verification: Create a dedicated Proxmox identity and verify it can list the target node and permitted resources without exposing credential material.

credentials.minimum_scope: Read network/DHCP state and manage only platform static DNS entries
credentials.storage_location: operator-managed secret store; injected only into edge automation
credentials.rotation_revocation: Replace the router identity credential, verify read-only access, then revoke the previous credential.
credentials.acquisition_verification: Create a dedicated RouterOS group and identity; verify identity and scope using a non-mutating resource listing.

credentials.minimum_scope: Manage platform proxy hosts and certificates without administrative-system exposure
credentials.storage_location: operator-managed secret store; injected only into edge automation
credentials.rotation_revocation: Rotate the NPM identity through its supported account workflow and remove the superseded session or identity.
credentials.acquisition_verification: Confirm the dedicated identity can enumerate platform proxy resources through a read-only check.

credentials.minimum_scope: Zone-scoped DNS edit and zone read for the single managed domain
credentials.storage_location: operator-managed secret store and approved CI secret store for named consumers
credentials.rotation_revocation: Issue a replacement zone-scoped identity, verify zone access, update consumers, and revoke the former identity.
credentials.acquisition_verification: Create a zone-scoped Cloudflare API identity and verify it can read only the intended zone metadata.

credentials.minimum_scope: Contents read/write only on explicitly selected application and GitOps repositories
credentials.storage_location: GitHub Actions secret or GitHub App installation configuration plus operator recovery record
credentials.rotation_revocation: Rotate or reinstall the repository-scoped identity and revoke previous grants after workflow verification.
credentials.acquisition_verification: Verify repository installation and permissions from GitHub settings without recording any credential value.

credentials.minimum_scope: Read packages for only the required private container packages
credentials.storage_location: encrypted GitOps bootstrap secret material; recovery copy in operator secret store
credentials.rotation_revocation: Replace the package-read identity, reconcile the encrypted pull secret, verify a test pull, then revoke the former identity.
credentials.acquisition_verification: Confirm package read access with the intended service identity outside repository content; do not save command output containing authentication material.
